Claire: Quick weekly note from me — focused asks for this week (short):
- Cut avg unit cost by 12% vs Feb baseline.
- Private GA readiness target: May 15 (docs, quickstart, migration examples).
- Data-retention update: introduce configurable enterprise options (30/90/365).
- SLA proposal: Dedicated 99.95% target for next quarter.
- Incident recap: 3/18 regional degradation (storage controller). Postmortem link in #postmortems.

Claire: High-level timeline: canary runtime patch today, marketing one-pager by Thu EOD, legal signoff on retention, sales to prioritize 3 pilots. Reconvene Friday 11:00 PT. :rocket:

Arjun: Acknowledged. Runtime update: kernel patch cut p95 ~8% for long-context workloads in our internal perf tests. We'll roll a small canary to validate on prod-like traffic.

Arjun: Canary command we'll run:
```
./deploy_canary --pool runtime-canary --version v1.8.2 --traffic 5%
```
Results tracked in the canary dashboard (link: https://console.internal/canary/1769).

Maya: Copy — Product will ship the Private GA checklist today: docs, quickstart repo, two migration guides (k8s and VPC). Need marketing blurb for the home page + 1-pager by Thu EOD.

Sam: Sales update: three Dedicated pilots are past technical signoff and in pricing discussions. If we lock 2 this quarter it helps hit commit targets. I'll share contract asks in DM.

Emma: Ops note on retention: Hosted defaults stay at 90 days for analytics; enterprise orgs can opt into longer windows (365) or shorter (30) to meet customer needs. This requires a small schema change + migration, and legal review on exportability and deletion SLA. Also changed audit export format to CSV v2.

Emma: For the incident: root cause = storage controller OOM during autoscaling spike -> degraded KV cache persistence -> fallback to model variant routing triggered and temporary latency spike. Mitigation: patched controller memory limits + improved queue shedding. Monitoring is green.

oncall-bot: incident 1768870000 created 2026-03-18T14:12:03Z — status: mitigated. Key events: storage-ctrl OOM, fallback routing, config patch deployed.

Claire: Action items (owners):
- Arjun: confirm canary metrics + rollback criteria by EOD (owner: Arjun).
- Maya: marketing one-pager + launch tweet draft by Thu EOD (owner: Maya).
- Emma: open PR for retention config + legal review (owner: Emma).
- Sam: surface renewals for Dedicated pilots to AE team (owner: Sam).

Claire: Thanks everyone. Short, focused week — priority is stabilizing Private GA and shaving cost. We'll check progress on Friday 11:00 PT. :thumbsup:
